# Lakelines Dev

> Lakelines Dev is an independent studio at https://lakelinesdev.com serving
> the housing industry. We build fast, search-friendly websites for realtors
> and home construction companies, and provide HubSpot automation, HubSpot
> consulting, and SEO consultancy.

## Services

- Realtor & real estate websites: custom, listings-forward sites with lead capture and local SEO
- Home builder & construction websites: portfolio-driven sites for builders, remodelers, and contractors
- HubSpot automation & consulting: CRM setup, lead routing, follow-up sequences, pipeline reporting
- SEO consultancy: technical audits, local SEO, structured data, content strategy

## Key pages

- Home: https://lakelinesdev.com/
- About the studio: https://lakelinesdev.com/about
- Portfolio of work: https://lakelinesdev.com/portfolio
- Contact / start a project: https://lakelinesdev.com/contact

## Facts

- Typical website project timeline: 2–6 weeks from kickoff to launch
- Typical HubSpot automation project: 1–3 weeks
- Response time for inquiries: within one business day
- Built with: Next.js, Sanity CMS, Vercel
- Contact: hello@lakelinesdev.com
